dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}! You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: So what's up, everything alright?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you settling in okay?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Yeah, you bet! Don't worry, I'm exceedingly good at adapting to new environments.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: There've been times in the past when I've had to make do with a rock for a pillow, or just find a patch of grass to lie down on. In the army, you learn how to sleep well wherever you are.

choices.text: So do you feel that life here is too relaxed?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Haha, why would you think that?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: If your bowstring is always drawn tight, it will eventually snap.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Relaxation is an essential part of improving as a fighter. So as far as I'm concerned, this place is the perfect antidote to the tension of battle!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Which brings me to you. I wanted to take this opportunity to express my sincere gratitude for everything you've done for me. Thank you!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: You've always been genuine with me, it truly warms my heart.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Anyway, don't worry, I'm not here to just take advantage and lounge around. I'm ready to switch to combat mode at a moment's notice!

choices.text: Well, you can finally take it easy here...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: *sigh*... Seems so.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Time of peace is hard to come by. I will cherish every moment of it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Sure!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: How about I tell you some stories from my time in the resistance? I can think of a few you're not likely to hear from anybody else...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd love to know more...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Alright! The truth is, not every soldier that joins the resistance goes through formal training, so new soldiers make small mistakes from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: For example, one time during a mock expedition, one of the new soldiers didn't store his rations carefully enough. They went bad, and he ended up eating nothing but Radishes for two whole weeks.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Another time during a scouting operation, a new soldier mistook animal trails for enemy trails. They ended up playing cat and mouse with a forest boar for three whole days...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Thankfully, these were just small oversights, and never caused any serious consequences. On the contrary, we often have a good laugh about these things during our down time.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: But when I think about it, I'm sure we would avoid issues like these if we reformed some of our guidelines.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: We should be mixing veteran soldiers and newer soldiers together. This way, veteran soldiers can act as mentors and share their experience with the newer soldiers...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Uh, my apologies, I began thinking out loud there!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I can go over these reforms some other time! Right now, I'm chatting with you, so I should keep it light.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to hear more about the Ever-Victorious General.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: ...You want to hear my story?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Uhh...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Soldiers love boasting about my military achievements to other people, but I always feel that talking about my own experience gives the impression I'm boasting.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Heh, you know I can't say no to you, don't you? ...Wait, that's why you asked, isn't it?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Heh... Alright, I guess there's no way out of this one...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Let me think... Okay, let me tell you the thrilling tale of my one-man scouting mission to the north of Nazuchi Beach.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Here's what I remember from that day...

choices.text: I would never think you're boasting.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Yeah! I heard from Tubby the Butler Bird that she can change the terrain to whatever you want.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: So, could you build a really tall mountain? The steeper the better — I want it to be a tough climb.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Then, let's you and I have a race to the top!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No problem.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Wow, you didn't take much persuading! Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I used to go mountain climbing with my resistance comrades all the time. It was a great way to test our physical limits while also having some fun together... I have so many treasured memories.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: But something tells me that the chance to climb a mountain with you would become the happiest memory of them all.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: In fact, I would love to share every happy moment with you.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Hah, you're too kind! Alright... how about we find a relatively safe mountain trail and see who makes it to the top the fastest? Are you up to the challenge!?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: The loser has to treat the winner to a three-course meal... and at least one of the courses has to be dessert...

choices.text: I... just want to touch your tail...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Uh? What a weird request...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: But, fine... if you win, of course!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: I... Fine, I'll allow it. But only if you win.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: For the sake of my tail, I will give it everything I got! If you're serious about winning this, you're gonna have your work cut out for you!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Right! We should probably warm up first...

choices.text: I want to use your tail as a pillow when I go to sleep...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: What!? My tail... as a pillow...

choices.text: Gorou, I also want to thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Gorou.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I've completed my training for the day. If you plan on leaving now, then let me accompany you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Gorou.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Rest well, friend. Remember that the secret to good sleep is letting go of all your worries.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Therefore, the "Ever-Victorious General" is here to protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: A village can provide troops, conceal provisions, assist with reconnaissance, and so on... They often function as key strategic locations in resistance operations.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: The layout of this village is quite conventional, I doubt anyone could point to anything that's out of place. You've clearly done your homework on Inazuma's environment!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I am thoroughly impressed by your abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Nothing beats a warm and cozy hot spring...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Just half an hour in a hot spring is enough to get rid of all the fatigue that accumulates during training and battle.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Do you mind if I take a dip now? Ooh! You wanna join me?
